ko_b: 모바일운전면허증 발급을 위해 필요한 절차로 옳은 것은?
ko_c: 본인 명의 스마트폰과 본인 인증을 통해 신청해야 한다.
tr_b: Which of the following procedures is correct when applying for a mobile driver’s license?
tr_c: Applications can be made using any app.
Applications must be made using a smartphone under the applicant’s name with identity verification.
Applications can only be made at the traffic civil service office of a police station.
A mobile driver’s license cannot be issued at a driver’s license test center.

ko_b: 도로교통법령상 운전면허증 발급에 대한 설명으로 옳지 않은 것은?
ko_c: 운전면허시험 합격일로부터 30일 이내에 운전면허증을 발급받아야 한다.
운전면허증을 잃어버린 경우에는 재발급 받을 수 있다.
tr_b: According to the Road Traffic Act, which of the following is NOT true about driver's license issuance?
tr_c: A driver’s license must be issued within 30 days of passing the driver's license test.
A driver’s license cannot be issued in English.
A mobile driver’s license can be issued.
A lost driver’s license can be reissued.

ko_b: 시·도 경찰청장이 발급한 국제운전면허증의 유효기간은 발급받은 날부터 몇 년인가?
tr_b: What is the validity period for an international driver's license issued by the commissioner of the City/Do  (Province) police agency from the date of issuance?
tr_c: 1 year
2 years
3 years
4 years

ko_b: 도로교통법상 승차정원 15인승의 긴급 승합자동차를 처음 운전하려고 할 때 필요한 조건으로 맞는 것은?
tr_b: According to the Road Traffic Act, which of the following is a prerequisite for driving an emergency passenger  vehicle with prescribed seating capacity of no more than 15 persons?
tr_c: Class I driver’s license for ordinary motor vehicles; 3 hours of traffic safety education
Class I driver’s license for special motor vehicles (large towing vehicles); 2 hours of traffic safety education
Class I driver’s license for special motor vehicles (recovery vehicles); 2 hours of traffic safety education
Class II driver’s license for ordinary motor vehicles; 3 hours of traffic safety education

ko_b: 도로교통법상 연습운전면허 효력의 유효 기간은?
tr_b: What is the period of validity of a learner’s permit according to the Road Traffic Act?
tr_c: 6 months from the date of issuance
1 year from the date of issuance
2 years from the date of issuance
3 years from the date of issuance

ko_b: 도로교통법상 운전면허의 조건 부과기준 중 운전면허증 기재방법으로 바르지 않는 것은?
tr_b: According to the Road Traffic Act, which of the following should NOT be indicated in a driver’s license regarding  the special conditions for allowance of driver’s license?
tr_c: A: Manual transmission
E: Deaf sign and convex mirror
G: Specially produced and approved car
H: Right direction indicator

ko_b: 승차정원이 11명인 승합자동차로 총중량 780킬로그램의 피견인자동차를 견인하고자 한다. 운전자가 취득해야하는 운전면허의  종류는?
tr_b: A vehicle with total weight of 780 kg is to be towed with an 11-seater passenger vehicle. Which of the following  driver’s license(s) must the driver hold?
tr_c: Class I driver’s license for ordinary motor vehicles and for small towing vehicles
Class II driver’s license for ordinary motor vehicles and Class I driver’s license for small towing vehicles
Class I driver’s license for ordinary motor vehicles and for recovery vehicles
Class II driver’s license for ordinary motor vehicles and Class I driver’s license for recovery vehicles

ko_b: 운전면허 종류별 운전할 수 있는 차에 관한 설명으로 맞는 것 2가지는?
ko_c: 제1종 대형면허로 아스팔트살포기를 운전할 수 있다.
제1종 보통면허로 덤프트럭을 운전할 수 있다.
제2종 보통면허로 250시시 이륜자동차를 운전할 수 있다.
제2종 소형면허로 원동기장치자전거를 운전할 수 있다.
tr_b: Which TWO statements are correct regarding the types of vehicles that can be driven by specific types of driver's  license?
tr_c: An asphalt distributor may be driven by a driver holding a Class I driver’s license for large motor vehicles.
A dump truck may be driven by a driver holding a Class I driver’s license for ordinary motor vehicles.
A 250 cc two-wheeled vehicle may be driven by a person holding a Class II driver’s license for ordinary motor vehicles.
A motorcycle may be driven by a person holding a Class II driver’s license for small motor vehicles.

ko_b: 승차정원이 12명인 승합자동차를 도로에서 운전하려고 한다. 운전자가 취득해야하는 운전면허의 종류는?
tr_b: One intends to drive a 12-seater passenger vehicle. Which of the following driver’s license types must one obtain  to do so?
tr_c: Class I driver’s license for large towing vehicles
Class I driver’s license for recovery vehicles
Class I driver’s license for ordinary motor vehicles
Class II driver’s license for ordinary motor vehicles

ko_b: 다음 중 제2종 보통면허를 취득할 수 있는 사람은?
ko_c: 한쪽 눈은 보지 못하나 다른 쪽 눈의 시력이 0.5인 사람
붉은색, 녹색, 노란색의 색채 식별이 불가능한 사람
tr_b: Which of the following people can obtain a Class II driver's license for ordinary motor vehicles?
tr_c: Those who are blind in one eye but possess visual acuity of 0.5 in the other eye
Those who cannot differentiate red, green, and yellow colors (color blind)
Those who are 17 years old
Those who are deaf

ko_b: 다음 중 도로교통법상 원동기장치자전거의 정의(기준)에 대한 설명으로 옳은 것은?
tr_b: Which of the following is a correct definition (standard) of a “motorcycle” under the Road Traffic Act?
tr_c: Displacement of up to 50 cc; maximum rated output power of up to 0.59 kW
Displacement of less than 50 cc; maximum rated output power of less than 0.59 kW
Displacement of up to 125 cc; maximum rated output power of up to 11 kW
Displacement of less than 125 cc; maximum rated output power of less than 11 kW

ko_b: 다음 중 도로교통법상 제1종 대형면허 시험에 응시할 수 있는 기준은? (이륜자동차 운전경력은 제외)
tr_b: According to the Road Traffic Act, which of the following are the qualifications for taking a test for Class I driver's license for a large motor vehicle? (Excluding experience in driving a two-wheeled vehicle)
tr_c: A person who has been driving a vehicle for at least 6 months and who is 18 years or older
A person who has been driving a vehicle for at least 1 year and who is 18 years or older
A person who has been driving a vehicle for at least 6 months and who is 19 years or older
A person who has been driving a vehicle for at least 1 year and who is 19 years or older

ko_b: 도로교통법령상 해외 출국 시, 운전면허 적성검사 연기에 대한 설명으로 틀린 것은?
ko_c: 출국 전 적성검사 연기 신청서를 제출해야 한다.
출국 후에는 대리인이 대신하여 적성검사 연기 신청을 할 수 없다.
적성검사 연기 신청 시, E-티켓과 같은 출국 사실을 증명할 수 있는 서류를 제출해야 한다.
적성검사 연기 신청이 승인된 경우, 귀국 후 3개월 이내에 적성검사를 받아야 한다.
tr_b: Which of the following is an incorrect description of postponing the driver's license aptitude test under the Road  Traffic Act when traveling abroad?
tr_c: You must submit an application to postpone the aptitude test before leaving the country.
You cannot have an agent apply for a postponement of the aptitude test on your behalf after you leave the country.
You must provide supporting documents of your departure such as an E-ticket to apply for a postponement of the  aptitude test.
If your application is approved, you must take the aptitude test within three months of your return.

ko_b: 도로주행시험에 불합격한 사람은 불합격한 날부터 (  )이 지난 후에 다시 도로주행시험에 응시할 수 있다.  (   )에 기준으로 맞는 것은?
tr_b: A person who fails the road driving test may retake the test (  ) after the date of failure. Which of the following  belongs in (  )?
tr_c: 1 day
3 days
5 days
7 days

ko_b: ‘착한운전 마일리지' 제도에 대한 설명으로 적절치 않은 2가지는?
ko_c: 교통법규를 잘 지키고 이를 실천한 운전자에게 실질적인 인센티브를 부여하는 제도이다.
운전자가 정지처분을 받게 될 경우 누산점수에서 공제할 수 있다.
범칙금이나 과태료 미납자도 마일리지 제도의 무위반․무사고 서약에 참여할 수 있다.
서약 실천기간 중에 교통사고를 유발하거나 교통법규를 위반하면 다시 서약할 수 없다.
tr_b: What are TWO inappropriate explanations for the "Good Driving Mileage" system?
tr_c: It is a system that provides practical incentives to those who comply with and practice traffic laws.
If a driver receives a suspension order, the penalty can be deducted from the accumulated points.
Those who have not paid the traffic penalty or administrative fine can participate in the no-violation, no-accident  pledge of the mileage system.
In case of causing a traffic accident or violating traffic laws during the pledge period, the person cannot take the  pledge again.

ko_b: 원동기 장치자전거 중 개인형 이동장치의 정의에 대한 설명으로 바르지 않은 것은?
ko_c: 시속 25킬로미터 이상으로 운행할 경우 전동기가 작동하지 않아야 한다.
tr_b: Which of the following is NOT the correct definition of personal mobility devices (PMDs) in motorcycle form?
tr_c: The ascent angle is less than 25 degrees.
The device must weigh less than 30 kg.
The term "bicycles, etc." means bicycles and personal mobility devices.
The motor should not operate when driving at a speed of 25 km/h or more.

ko_b: 도로교통법 상 개인형 이동장치의 기준에 대한 설명이다. 바르게 설명된 것은?
ko_c: 원동기를 단 차 중 시속 20킬로미터 이상으로 운행할 경우 전동기가 작동하지 아니하여야 한다.
전동기의 동력만으로 움직일 수 없는(PAS : Pedal Assist System) 전기자전거를 포함한다.
최고 정격출력 11킬로와트 이하의 원동기를 단 차로 차체 중량이 35킬로그램 미만인 것을 말한다.
tr_b: Below are explanations of the standard for personal mobility devices (PMDs) according to the Road Traffic Act.  Which one is correct?
tr_c: For vehicles with a motor, the motor should stop when the device reaches or exceeds a speed of 20 km/h.
It includes electric bicycles that cannot move solely by motor power (PAS: Pedal Assist System).
It is a vehicle with maximum rated output power of 11 kW or less, which weighs less than 35 kg.
The weight of the vehicle should be less than 30 kg.

ko_b: 다음 중 운전면허 취득 결격기간이 2년에 해당하는 사유 2가지는?
ko_c: 다른 사람을 위하여 운전면허시험에 대리 응시한 때
단속 경찰관 폭행으로 입건되어 취소가 되는 경우
음주운전을 하다가 3회 이상 교통사고를 일으킨 경우
tr_b: Which TWO actions would cause someone to be barred from acquiring a driver's license for 2 years? (If given a  penalty more severe than a criminal fine)
tr_c: Driving without a license three times
When taking a driver’s license test on behalf of another person.
When charged for assaulting a police officer during an inspection, resulting in the revocation of one’s license.
When causing three or more traffic accidents while driving under the influence of alcohol.

ko_b: 도로교통법령상 영문운전면허증에 대한 설명으로 옳지 않은 것은?(제네바협약 또는 비엔나협약 가입국으로 한정)
ko_c: 영문운전면허증 인정 국가에서 운전할 때 별도의 번역공증서 없이 운전이 가능하다.
영문운전면허증 인정 국가에서는 체류기간에 상관없이 사용할 수 있다.
영문운전면허증 불인정 국가에서는 한국운전면허증, 국제운전면허증, 여권을 지참해야 한다.
운전면허증 뒤쪽에 영문으로 운전면허증의 내용을 표기한 것이다.
tr_b: According to the Road Traffic Act, which of the following is NOT true about an English driver’s license? (Limited  to countries that have ratified the Geneva Convention or the Vienna Convention)
tr_c: When driving in a country where an English driver’s license is recognized, it is possible to drive without a separate  notarized translation.
The English driver's license can be used regardless of the length of stay in a country where an English driver’s license is  recognized.
You should bring your Korean driver's license, an international driver's license, and your passport in a country where an English driver’s license is not recognized.
It is a license wherein the content of the driver's license is written in English on the back of the driver's license.

ko_b: 도로교통법상 원동기장치자전거는 전기를 동력으로 하는 경우에는 최고정격출력 ( )이하의 이륜자동차 이다. (   )에 기준 으로 맞는 것은?
tr_b: Under the Road Traffic Act, a motorcycle is defined as a two-wheeled vehicle with maximum rated output of  (  ) or less when powered by electricity. Which of the following belongs in (  )?
tr_c: 11 kW
9 kW
5 kW

ko_b: 다음 중 도로교통법에서 규정하고 있는 "연석선" 정의로 맞는 것은?
ko_c: 차마의 통행방향을 명확하게 구분하기 위한 선
자동차가 한 줄로 도로의 정하여진 부분을 통행하도록 한 선
차도와 보도를 구분하는 돌 등으로 이어진 선
tr_b: Which of the following is the correct definition of "line of curbstones" as stipulated in the Road Traffic Act?
tr_c: A line indicating the direction of the thoroughfare for vehicles and horses
A line for guiding vehicles to drive in a single line through a set part of the road
A line consisting of rocks or other material for distinguishing roadways from sidewalks
A line indicating separate lanes

ko_b: 도로교통법상 개인형 이동장치와 관련된 내용으로 올바른 것은?
ko_c: 운전면허를 반납한 65세 이상인 사람이 운전할 수 있다.
13세 이상인 사람이 운전면허 취득 없이 운전할 수 있다.
횡단보도를 이용할 때에는 개인형 이동장치에서 내려 끌거나 들고 보행하여야 한다.
tr_b: Which of the following statements regarding personal mobility devices under the Road Traffic Act is correct?
tr_c: It is possible to drive a PMD with more riders than the permitted capacity.
A person over the age of 65 who has returned his/her driver’s license can drive a PMD.
A person over the age of 13 can drive a PMD without a driver’s license.
When using a crosswalk, you must get off the personal mobility device and push or carry it while walking.

ko_b: 도로교통법령상 고령자 면허 갱신 및 적성검사의 주기가 3년인 사람의 연령 기준으로 맞는 것은?
tr_b: According to the Road Traffic Act, which of the following is the age standard for individuals whose driver's  license renewal and aptitude test interval is 3 years?
tr_c: Individuals aged 65 or older
Individuals aged 70 or older
Individuals aged 75 or older
Individuals aged 80 or older

ko_b: 다음은 도로교통법령상 운전면허증을 발급 받으려는 사람의 본인여부 확인 절차에 대한 설명이다. 틀린 것은?
ko_c: 주민등록증을 분실한 경우 주민등록증 발급신청 확인서로 가능하다.
신분증명서 또는 지문정보로 본인여부를 확인 할 수 없으면 시험에 응시할 수 없다.
신청인의 동의 없이 전자적 방법으로 지문정보를 대조하여 확인할 수 있다.
본인여부 확인을 거부하는 경우 운전면허증 발급을 거부할 수 있다.
tr_b: Below are descriptions of the verification process for identifying individuals wishing to obtain a driver’s license according to the Road Traffic Act and its Enforcement Decree. Which of the following is NOT correct?
tr_c: If the resident registration card has been lost, identification can be performed via the confirmation of application for the issuance of a resident registration card.
An individual who cannot be verified by either identification certificate or fingerprint information is not permitted to  take the test.
Fingerprint information may be compared and verified using an electronic method without the applicant's consent.
If the applicant refuses to verify his/her own identity, the issuance of a driver’s license may be denied.

ko_b: 다음 중 수소대형승합자동차(승차정원 35인승 이상)를 신규로 운전하려는 운전자에 대한 특별교육을 실시하는 기관은?
tr_b: Which of the following government authorities provides special education to those intending to get a license for  fuel cell electric buses (FCEBs; seating capacity of 35 or more)?
tr_c: Korea Gas Safety Corporation
Korea Occupational Safety and Health Agency
Korea Road Traffic Authority
Korea Expressway Corporation

ko_b: 도로교통법상 교통법규 위반으로 운전면허 효력 정지처분을 받을 가능성이 있는 사람이 특별교통안전 권장교육을  받고자 하는 경우 누구에게 신청하여야 하는가?  (음주운전 제외)
tr_b: Whom must the person likely to have his/her driver’s license suspended due to a violation of traffic laws according to the Road Traffic Act request when wishing to receive the recommended special traffic safety education? (Driving under the influence excluded)
tr_c: Chairperson of the Korea Road Traffic Authority
Head of the local government having jurisdiction over one's domicile
Head of a driver licensing office
Commissioner of a City/Do police agency

ko_b: 도로교통법령상 한쪽 눈을 보지 못하는 사람이 제1종 보통면허를 취득하려는 경우 다른 쪽 눈의 시력이 (    ) 이상,  수평시야가 (   )도 이상, 수직시야가 20도 이상, 중심시야 20도 내 암점과 반맹이 없어야 한다.  (     )안에 기준으로 맞는  것은?
tr_b: According to the Road Traffic Act and its Enforcement Decree, if a person who is blind in one eye intends to obtain a Class I driver's license for ordinary motor vehicles, the visual acuity of his/her other eye shall be at least ( ), he/she shall have altitudinal visual range of ( ) degrees and vertical visual range of 20 degrees, and there shall be no scotoma and hemianopia within the central visual range of 20 degrees. Which answer fits in the two ( )s?

ko_b: 제1종 운전면허를 발급받은 65세 이상 75세 미만인 사람(한쪽 눈만 보지 못하는 사람은 제외)은 몇 년마다 정기적성검사 를 받아야 하나?
tr_b: How often is a person between 65 and 75 years of age with a Class I driver’s license (excluding persons who  have lost sight in only one eye) required to take a regular aptitude test?
tr_c: Every 3 years
Every 5 years
Every 10 years
Every 15 years

ko_b: 운전면허증을 시·도경찰청장에게 반납하여야 하는 사유 2가지는?
ko_c: 운전면허 효력 정지의 처분을 받은 때
tr_b: When should drivers return their driver's license to the commissioner of the City/Do (Province) police agency?  (Select TWO)
tr_c: When they have their driver's license revoked
When they have their driver's license suspended
When they are notified that they should take an occasional aptitude test
If they fail to take a regular aptitude test for 6 months

ko_b: 도로교통법상 운전면허증 갱신기간을 올바르게 설명한 것은? (65세 미만의 운전자에 한한다)

ko_c: 음주운전 방지장치가 설치된 자동차등을 시·도경찰청에 등록하지 아니하고 운전한 경우에는 면허가 정지 된다.
음주운전 방지장치가 설치되지 아니하거나 설치기준에 부합하지 아니한 음주운전 방지장치가 설치된 자동차등을 운전       한 경우 1개월 내 시정조치 명령을 한다.

음주운전으로 인한 면허 결격기간 이후 방지장치 부착차량만 운전가능한 면허를 취득한 때부터 장치를 부착한 차량만       운행할 수 있다.
tr_b: Which of the following is correct regarding the obligations of a driver who has obtained a conditional driver’s  license upon installing an ignition interlock device under the Road Traffic Act?
tr_c: A person who has obtained a conditional driver’s license upon installing an ignition interlock device and who drives without registering it with the commissioner of the city or police agency of his/her municipality will have his/her license suspended.
A person who has driven a vehicle without an ignition interlock device or with such device that fails to meet the installation standards shall be ordered to take corrective measures within one month.

A person who drives a motor vehicle with an ignition interlock device, etc. knowing that the device is less effective as it was dismantled, tampered with, or otherwise for maintenance will have his/her license suspended.

After the period of license disqualification due to drunk driving, a person may only drive a vehicle with an ignition interlock device from the time of obtaining a conditional driver’s license upon installing an ignition interlock device.
